rules: Names are forever: a tool, field or error code is never renamed or removed within a major version. Additions are optional fields or new tools only.
Every refusal is a tool result with isError true whose text is JSON {error_code, error, retry_after_s?}. Nothing is sent on a refusal and nothing is queued.
to is one recipient object, never a list. No bulk tool exists.
Fields marked local_only are accepted by self-hosted servers only; an agent that never sends them works everywhere.

Pre-release correction 2026-10-23: where a tool was live on the hosted API before the contract was written, its live hosted schema is the contract (field names, required fields, enums, limits, output fields). Additions marked hosted_only are accepted by self-hosted servers and ignored there.

Lifecycle tools (connect_*, get_*_qr, get_*_status, submit_*, disconnect_*) keep the hosted connection API shape: success results carry success: true and phone_number, and a refusal is {success: false, error_code: <HTTP status as an integer>, error}. Every other tool refuses with a WireError (string error_code).
An unknown chat_id used as a filter (list_messages, wait_for_messages, search_messages) returns an empty list; a malformed one is invalid_chat_id. mark_read on an unknown chat is contact_not_found.

channel.description: whatsapp_web, telegram or linkedin on the doors; the hosted API may name other channels.

code.description: Platform error number; self-hosted servers use 0 when the platform gives none.

linkedin_username.description: Public id from the profile URL.

reason.description: Hosted only: a sub-reason on some codes (linkedin_gap, linkedin_claim_lost).

shared_tools.name: send_message
shared_tools.description: Send one message to one recipient.

to.description: One recipient object; fields per channel.

text.description: Message text, or the caption when media is attached. Required, up to 4096 characters.

media_url.description: An https URL of an image, video, audio file or document to attach.

media_path.description: Absolute path to a local file.

opt_in.description: True only when this person agreed to hear from you. Hosted: lets a first message to a new contact go past the free new contact limit. Self-hosted servers accept it and log it.

shared_tools.output: {message_id, status: "queued" (hosted) | "sent" (self-hosted, already delivered to the platform), reply_to_applied}

shared_tools.name: wait_for_messages
shared_tools.description: Long poll for new inbound messages. Without a cursor it starts from now.

shared_tools.name: get_usage
shared_tools.output: {plan, day, sends, sends_cap, new_contacts, new_contacts_cap, status: "active"|"suspended", suspended_reason?, accounts_total, accounts_connected, accounts_cap, ramp_day? (self-hosted), contract_version}

shared_tools.name: search_messages
shared_tools.description: Full text search over stored messages.

contact_id.description: A chat id from list_chats or a message; groups included.

tools.name: connect_whatsapp
tools.description: Start linking a WhatsApp account as a linked device, by QR code (default) or by pairing code.

phone_number.description: The WhatsApp number to link, in E.164, for example +31612345678.

force_new.description: Start a fresh link even when a session exists.

tools.output: {success: true, phone_number, status: "qr_pending" ("connected" self-hosted when already linked), session_id, connect_url? (hosted), connect_url_expires_at? (hosted), poll_qr_path? (hosted), poll_status_path? (hosted), qr_png_base64? (self-hosted), pairing_code? (self-hosted)}. A refusal is {success: false, error_code: <HTTP status>, error}.

tools.name: get_whatsapp_qr
tools.description: Get the current pairing QR code as an image.

phoneNumber.description: The WhatsApp number of the connection, in E.164 (the phone_number given to connect_whatsapp).

tools.output: {success: true, phone_number, status: "qr_pending", qr_code, qr_data_url, expires_at} (self-hosted also returns the QR as image content). A refusal is {success: false, error_code: <HTTP status>, error}.

tools.name: get_whatsapp_status
tools.description: Get the WhatsApp account status.

phoneNumber.description: The WhatsApp number of the connection, in E.164 (the phone_number given to connect_whatsapp).

tools.output: {success: true, phone_number, status: "not_initialized"|"qr_pending"|"connecting"|"connected"|"open"|"disconnected" (self-hosted adds "restricted"), has_qr, qr_expires_at, last_activity, message_count, proxy, live, limits? (self-hosted)}. A refusal is {success: false, error_code: <HTTP status>, error}.

tools.name: disconnect_whatsapp
tools.description: Unlink the WhatsApp account.

phoneNumber.description: The WhatsApp number of the connection, in E.164 (the phone_number given to connect_whatsapp).

tools.output: {success: true, phone_number, status: "removed"|"disconnected"}. A refusal is {success: false, error_code: <HTTP status>, error}.

telegram_user_id.description: Numeric Telegram user id of a user this account has seen, as a string.

telegram_username.description: Public username, with or without @, or a t.me link.

phone.description: Phone number of someone in this account's Telegram contacts (user accounts only).

contact_id.description: Any chat id from list_chats or a message (private chats, groups, channels).

tools.name: connect_telegram
tools.description: Start logging in a Telegram user account. Telegram sends a code to your Telegram app or by SMS; pass it to submit_telegram_code.

phone_number.description: Your phone number in international format, for example +31612345678.

mode.description: code (default) or qr. Self-hosted servers support code only.

force_new.description: Start a fresh login even when a session exists.

tools.output: {success: true, phone_number, status: "code_required"|"qr_required"|"initializing" ("connected" self-hosted when already logged in), session_id, login_token? (hosted), qr_url? (hosted), connect_url? (hosted), connect_url_expires_at? (hosted)}. A refusal is {success: false, error_code: <HTTP status>, error}.

tools.name: submit_telegram_code
tools.description: Submit the login code Telegram sent.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number given to connect_telegram.

tools.output: {success: true, phone_number, status: "connected"|"password_required", telegram_user_id, username, hint? (self-hosted)}. A refusal is {success: false, error_code: <HTTP status>, error}.

tools.name: submit_telegram_password
tools.description: Submit the two step verification password, when submit_telegram_code returned password_required.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number given to connect_telegram.

tools.output: {success: true, phone_number, status: "connected"|"password_required", telegram_user_id, username}. A refusal is {success: false, error_code: <HTTP status>, error}.

tools.name: get_telegram_status
tools.description: The Telegram account: connection status, identifier and today's limits.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number given to connect_telegram.

tools.output: {success: true, phone_number, status: "connected"|"code_required"|"password_required"|"initializing"|"disconnected"|"not_initialized"|"error", telegram_user_id, live, limits? (self-hosted)}. A refusal is {success: false, error_code: <HTTP status>, error}.

tools.name: disconnect_telegram
tools.description: Log out of Telegram and delete the saved session.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number given to connect_telegram.

tools.output: {success: true, phone_number, status: "removed"}. A refusal is {success: false, error_code: <HTTP status>, error}.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List groups and supergroups. Same as list_chats with type group.
tools.output: {chats: [{chat_id, channel, name, type, unread_count, last_message_at}]}

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List broadcast channels. Same as list_chats with type channel.
tools.output: {chats: [{chat_id, channel, name, type, unread_count, last_message_at}]}

error_codes.invalid_input: Local only: an input field is missing or malformed.
error_codes.telegram_error: Local only: any other Telegram error, named in error.

notes: rate_limited covers Telegram FLOOD_WAIT (retry_after_s is the wait) and PEER_FLOOD (sends to new contacts stop until local midnight).
not_available_for_bots is returned in bot mode for calls Telegram does not allow bots to make.
Self-hosted servers add bot mode through the CLI or TELEMCP_BOT_TOKEN, with no extra tool.
In bot mode (self-hosted) there is no phone number: the lifecycle tools accept any phoneNumber value and report phone_number null.

linkedin_username.description: Public id from the profile URL.

contact_id.description: A chat id from list_chats or a message.

tools.name: connect_linkedin
tools.description: Sign in with the li_at cookie of your own LinkedIn session.
tools.output: WireAccount

tools.name: get_linkedin_status
tools.description: Get the LinkedIn account status.
tools.output: WireAccount

tools.name: disconnect_linkedin

tools.output: {linkedin_username, profile_url, name, headline, location, about, experience[], education[]}

tools.name: get_person_profile
tools.description: Read one profile. Counts as a profile view.

linkedin_username.description: Public id from the profile URL.

tools.output: {linkedin_username, profile_url, name, headline, location, about, experience[], education[], connection_degree}

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Find people by keywords. Counts as a search.
tools.output: {people: [{linkedin_username, profile_url, name, headline, location}], next_start?}

tools.name: connect_with_person
tools.description: Send a connection request, with an optional note without links.

linkedin_username.description: Public id from the profile URL.

tools.output: {status: "sent"|"pending"|"already_connected", invitation_id?}

tools.name: list_invitations
tools.description: List sent or received invitations.
tools.output: {invitations: [{id, direction, linkedin_username, name, sent_at, note?}]}

tools.name: accept_invitation
tools.description: Accept a received invitation. Counts as an accept.
tools.output: {accepted: true}

error_codes.no_connected_account: No account is connected (not paired, logged out, or the connection is down).
error_codes.account_suspended: The platform refused the session (WhatsApp 403, Telegram ban). Sending is stopped.
error_codes.invalid_recipient: The recipient is malformed, a list, or not on the platform.
error_codes.contact_not_found: No chat or contact with that id is known (mark_read, send_message to.contact_id).
error_codes.daily_send_cap: Today's message cap is reached. retry_after_s points to the next local midnight on self-hosted.
error_codes.new_contact_cap: Today's new contact cap is reached. retry_after_s points to the next local midnight on self-hosted.
error_codes.media_unavailable: The media file or URL cannot be used.
error_codes.password_required: A two step password is needed.
error_codes.invalid_code: The login code or password is wrong.
error_codes.message_not_found: No message with that id is known.
error_codes.session_expired: The LinkedIn cookie no longer signs in. Sign in again with connect_linkedin.
error_codes.security_challenge: LinkedIn asked for a security check. Writes are paused for 48 hours; finish the check in a browser.
error_codes.outside_working_hours: Outside the configured working hours. retry_after_s points to the next window start.
error_codes.link_not_allowed: A link in a connection note, or in a message to a person who has not written back in this thread. The text is refused, not edited.
error_codes.daily_invite_cap: Today's connection request cap is reached. retry_after_s points to the next local midnight.
error_codes.daily_read_cap: Today's profile view or search cap is reached. retry_after_s points to the next local midnight.
error_codes.needs_connection_first: A new LinkedIn thread can only be opened with a first degree connection.
error_codes.account_not_found: account_id is not one of your accounts.
error_codes.invalid_request: A field has the wrong type or value.
error_codes.invalid_text: text is missing or longer than 4096 characters.
error_codes.invalid_media_url: media_url is not an https URL.
error_codes.invalid_reply_to: reply_to is not a message id.
error_codes.invalid_cursor: cursor or before is not a cursor this server returned.
error_codes.invalid_query: query is missing, too short or too long.
error_codes.invalid_type: type is not user, group or channel.
error_codes.invalid_direction: direction is not inbound or outbound.
error_codes.ambiguous_account: Hosted only: several accounts are connected; pass account_id.
error_codes.contact_opted_out: Hosted only: the contact opted out.
error_codes.contact_do_not_disturb: Hosted only: the contact has do not disturb on.
error_codes.contact_private: Hosted only: the contact is marked private.
error_codes.contact_account_mismatch: Hosted only: contact_id belongs to another account.
error_codes.contact_channel_mismatch: Hosted only: contact_id is on another channel.
error_codes.wait_concurrency: Hosted only: too many wait_for_messages calls at once; retry_after_s.
error_codes.internal_error: Hosted only: an unexpected server error.
